Footpad drag test on RS soil (Red Crushed Volcanic Scoria (narrowly graded)) at relative density 0; apparatus: subscale drag test equipment (SSD); loading: constant penetration drag: depth d 1/2 to 4 inch (table) held by locking the piston to the air cylinder; carriage accelerated by rubber bungee cords, then pulled at constant V_H by cam rod and friction drive wheel, then decelerated by springs and damper. Recorded: horizontal velocity V_H; drag load F_D; vertical load F_V; footpad pitch angle alpha; bed g_p from dynamic penetrometer with D_r and gamma; derived F_D/(d gamma A_ft), V_H/sqrt(dg), F_D/A_ft, F_V/A_pt as printed; one midpoint reading per run.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The 32 runs below were transcribed from the printed table by two readings made separately, which agree in every cell; 9 runs carry a note from the arithmetic check of the printed derived columns. No person has yet checked the values of these runs against the scan. The test setup is incomplete: fill depth is not reported.
:::

## Data

Download: [runs.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-drag-f4-6a/runs.csv) (32 runs, one physical test per row: every printed value in SI and as printed, the four derived columns the report prints, and the arithmetic check of each row) and [runs.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-drag-f4-6a/runs.json) (units, conversion factors, how the table was read).

The report defines the areas in the derived columns only by name (A_ft the total horizontal frontal area, A_pt the vertical frontal area of the footpad, Fig. 4-4); the depth d is measured from the soil surface to the bottom of the pad at zero pitch. Checked against each other, the two pressure columns agree only with a common factor of 0.9738 to 0.9763, which every run fits: the factor a unit weight of 40.02 to 40.13 rather than the printed 41.1 pcf would give in the authors' arithmetic; which input differs, the page does not say. The `check` column names the runs outside the printed rounding and the heuristic flags of the areas each run implies.
